economic_method_source.biogas_price_unit_evidence: DATA2 row57 formula multiplies raw m3 by parameters E4; converting E4/23.31 reproduces SI USD/MJ range. Electricity and heat native outputs and prices are MJ and USD/MJ.

gross_cost_contract.definition: Direct annualized CapEx + OpEx. C_gross=sum_route(m_route_t*treatment_cost_route_USD2020_per_t)+m_controlled_t*collection_transfer_USD2020_per_t. No separate sorting fee appears in the recovered source. Collection is charged once per controlled tonne, not multiplied by distance. D&AF own treatment cost uses the source C&T-category proxy in addition to the common collection charge, as in the recovered matrix. No product benefits, taxes/subsidies or GHG credits.

Permissive.sorting_cost: Retain original PMM classify_cost on classified MSW; no added or removed fee.
Permissive.definition: Gross cost = sum(route_mass_t*treatment_USD2020_per_t) + controlled_mass_t*(collect_cost+route_transport_cost) + classified_mass_t*classify_cost. This exactly preserves the original PMM compute_metrics economic structure; no fee is removed or added.
Permissive.legacy_comparison: PMM retains its existing valid collection, route transport and classification fees. This local cost definition overrides the general managed-archetype collection-once definition. The legacy gross aggregate is also logged for numerical reconciliation. Components may share a numeric proxy without being assumed to represent the same service.
